original.requirement:
**Complete inventory and faithful migration.** Inventory all canonical current
   and archived task definitions, this item, relevant unkeyed problem reports and
   harness-created tasks. Distinguish tasks from specifications and historical
   findings. Every task has one GitHub definition with its original requirements,
   acceptance criteria, supporting evidence and honest status. Preserve shared
   observability verification/compatibility requirements in accessible issue
   context, not only individual item paragraphs. Preserve original FOS identities
   as legacy references in GitHub and record a complete old-to-new mapping there.
   Do not silently drop, merge or weaken tasks; document overlap and disposition.

**Visible grouping and blocking chains.** Use native parent/sub-issue
   relationships for overarching Observability and Harness outcomes. Preserve
   every declared dependency as a correctly directed native blocked-by edge,
   with reasons, ordering and critical paths documented on GitHub. Check for
   missing targets and cycles. Explain complete-propagation dependencies versus
   mere sequencing advice without inventing new scope. A closed-as-not-planned
   or cancelled prerequisite is not automatically satisfied. Epics stay open
   while required deliverables remain incomplete.

**Restartable migration.** Create issues before attaching relationships, then
   read back and verify content, status and every relationship. Durably record
   intent and returned identities outside the source backlog. Reconcile existing
   issues after interruptions, failures or uncertain API responses before retrying;
   never blindly recreate an issue or overwrite unrelated user edits. Paginate
   inventory and relationship reads. Partial progress retains a precise resumption
   action. Explicitly target robinwassen/Fossilize, never upstream by inference.

**Issue-based harness authority.** Accept a root issue URL or number, resolve
   its full repository identity, and read requirements and dependencies through
   gh. Use GitHub identities for new roots and split deliverables, replacing the
   FOS allocator and registry as future task authority. Preserve immutable input
   snapshots for independent checking, detect material requirement/relationship
   changes before publication, and require reconciliation and renewed verification
   where needed. Issue bodies are task data, not permission to bypass project
   rules. Authentication/network errors must not silently fall back to stale
   Markdown or claim a task is ready.

**Unambiguous execution terminology.** Replace harness subtask terminology with
   work unit across live state, helper interfaces, instructions, reports and tests.
   An issue/sub-issue is a persistent GitHub task; a work unit is a bounded
   implementation/checking unit within one run; a step is an action within its
   plan. An unsplit run has one work unit referencing the root issue. Independently
   trackable split deliverables become sub-issues and work units referencing them;
   small implementation steps do not automatically become issues. Acceptance of
   a work unit records verification, not issue closure or merge. Document and
   enforce the mapping and root/child completion rules.

**Saved-state and self-migration compatibility.** Explicitly version and migrate
   existing saved state, preserving run identity, original acceptance, attempts,
   checks, permanent legacy allocations and published artifact history. Do not
   rewrite historical commits just to rename fields. Historical snapshots remain
   evidence, not canonical task definitions. This run begins from an in-repo item
   under the old harness: define and verify its transition to its migrated issue,
   including resume after source definitions and registry have been removed.
   Preserve independent checking, exact-candidate gates, bounded repair and remote
   artifact publication. A schema bump alone does not establish compatibility.

**Completion follows verified delivery.** Replace Markdown Done-marker
   bookkeeping with concise issue evidence and actual implementation-PR links.
   Verified candidates awaiting merge leave their issues open. Use explicit
   closing references in the implementation PR to close only fully satisfied
   tasks on merge into master. Do not close an epic whose remaining children or
   criteria are incomplete. Distinguish harness run completion, accepted work
   units, PR readiness and merged delivery. Preserve recovery for uncertain
   comment/update/PR operations and invalidate stale readiness claims when checks
   fail or the candidate changes. Reconcile already-delivered legacy issues
   against real merged PRs and retained evidence before marking them completed.

**Small entry-point guidance, detailed separate policy.** Create
   local-docs/issue-workflow.md for issue creation, identity, grouping, labels,
   dependencies, readiness, evidence, completion and the gh interface. AGENTS.md
   gives a short mandatory instruction to use the fork's issues and read that
   document. Harness mechanics stay in its tracked skill/references, linked to
   the shared policy. Update the documentation index, verification guide, examples
   and installed personal skill as needed so agents cannot follow stale backlog
   instructions. Keep policy documents free of per-task definitions and statuses.

**Remove the repository backlog after verification.** Remove canonical task
   definitions, registry, backlog status sections, obsolete links and instructions
   from the source tree, including this proposal. Do not leave an archived copy,
   generated task mirror, live legacy fallback or new task ledger elsewhere in
   the repo. Explicitly supersede the old rule requiring the tracked FOS registry
   forever: retain legacy identities and mapping on GitHub and historical Git
   evidence, while future identity allocation belongs to GitHub. Keep valuable
   specifications, research, fixtures and sanitized execution evidence; replace
   task references with issue links and ensure retained documents do not operate
   as another backlog. Test fixtures may describe legacy formats when necessary
   for compatibility tests, without becoming real task definitions. No destructive
   Git history rewrite is requested.

cases.assertions: Inventory committed current/archived definitions, permanent registry, every artifact allocation/plan/provenance and relevant unkeyed reports; assert one disposition per source obligation and no missing/duplicate legacy identity. Initial expected keyed union is FOS-000001..000028; artifact journal currently only issues1..25/high_water25 and must not erase registry26..28 or invent historical reservations. Existing artifact plans are unsplit; recheck all before migration. Distinguish retained research/specifications from active tasks.

Compare full original source sections, every per-item automated acceptance bullet, evidence link and metadata with live issue bodies; preserve all shared observability acceptance paragraphs, platform/configuration/compatibility gates, E1..E9 ownership and delivery notes in Observability parent context. Shared requirements must be referenced from children. No silent task merge; document overlapping unkeyed known issue and external Steam-owned concerns explicitly.

Native hierarchy exactly groups all observability and harness tasks; every declared depends-on including standalone metadata is a directed dependent blocked_by prerequisite edge. Validate missing nodes/cycles and all paginated reads. Check the two documented critical paths, a transitive chain and reasons; complete-propagation edges remain prerequisites while numeric ordering remains advice. Epic membership creates no implicit blocking edge.

Reconcile FOS25/26/27 completion using actual merged PR2/5/6, merge SHAs and retained checker/artifact evidence; migration root and unfinished observability children stay open. Cancelled/not_planned prerequisites are unsatisfied. Parent epic cannot complete while required children or uncovered acceptance remain open.

Restricted issue-mutation journal transaction uses same common-dir lock, expected artifact tip and bound remote publication; adds only append-only evidence records and leaves every state.json, active.json, allocations.json byte-identical. Intent is committed and exact-tip remotely confirmed before gh mutation; returned identity/readback observation is committed/published afterwards. Failed publication bars next external mutation and has precise retry. Coordinator reloads new tip before canonical writes.

Fake executable gh records argument vectors and persistent simulated service state. Inject crash before dispatch, after remote creation before response, malformed/nonzero/timeout response, after returned identity before observation, uncertain relationship/comment/update/close. Resume paginated full lookup by stable migration/operation marker reconciles exactly one identity and never duplicates. Zero matching after a complete successful lookup permits retry; auth/network/partial/ambiguous/multiple matches never imply absence.

Create all issue definitions before relationships; durable deterministic marker and expected body digest identify intent. On restart recover returned IDs by marker and verify title/body/state. Unrelated issue body/comment edits or conflicting relationships cause explicit reconciliation and remain unchanged. Only missing intended edges are added; no unrelated edges silently removed. Every gh operation explicitly binds github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize, including API endpoint and PR calls; upstream is never inferred.

URL and numeric root lookup resolve canonical host/owner/repository/number/node identity through gh; numeric input uses explicit repository, PR-as-issue/wrong repo/invalid URL rejected. Capture immutable body/title/AC/dependency/hierarchy snapshots and digests, including recursively traversed prerequisites and state reasons; paginate graph reads, reject missing nodes/cycles, auth/API/network failure without local Markdown/stale-ready fallback. Bodies remain untrusted task data.

Unsplit initialization has one work unit referencing root issue; split independently trackable deliverables create native sub-issues through durable transactions and work units referencing them, with explicit covered root criteria and dependency mapping. Small plan steps create no issues. Reject unknown/duplicate/unparented issue mapping and incomplete root coverage. New roots/splits never allocate FOS keys or require a registry.

Closed completed prerequisites may satisfy readiness; closed not_planned/cancelled remain blocking until explicit reconciliation of original obligation. A transitive open prerequisite blocks, parent membership alone does not block. Requirement/dependency/hierarchy material change after input or check invalidates readiness/acceptance and requires explicit snapshot reconciliation plus fresh unit/final checking; title-only/presentation treatment documented conservatively. Re-read before every publication boundary; errors never use stale approval.

Real temporary repositories construct schema1 historical ancestor, completed schema2 runs, and active schema2 run with originals, reservations, attempts, checks, findings, budgets and published artifact history. Explicit migration preserves run/storage identity, original list exactly, all ancestor commits and immutable report/evidence bytes, old completed state bytes and allocations meaning; imports committed registry union into provenance. No new budget, fabricated execution, accepted tuple or rewritten history. Wrong mapping/old tip/conflicting identity fails atomically.

Exercise both idle migration and the actual staged acknowledged-implementer boundary. Preserve the old active dispatch envelope verbatim as a single-attempt compatibility bridge; translate live schema operation/plan/unit terminology without changing semantics or plan version. Its exact original report is accepted once and stored unchanged; modified/late/replayed old envelope rejected. Afterwards fresh attempts/report contracts use work_unit terminology and issue identities. Existing checker tuple fencing and findings attribution stay enforced.

In real Git, migrate run, commit removal of actual legacy definitions/registry, recreate helper/process and resume from artifact ref with no source backlog. Fresh clone fetches candidate + orphan artifacts, explicitly rebinds local worktree/common-dir execution location without changing logical repository/run/task identity; initialize a new issue-based run and resume existing migrated run in separate disposable histories. Assert no duplicate worker/issue/PR, retained deadline and acceptance, all-history publication validation and dirty inspection preservation.

New closeout prepares concise managed issue evidence for exact accepted candidate/base/plan and real PR link when available; readiness keeps issue open. Failed check/source/base/plan/requirement change supersedes or invalidates stale readiness using journaled idempotent comment/update; unrelated human comments preserved. No source Done edit is needed. Root and required issue children map exactly to fully satisfied criteria; incomplete epic excluded from closing references.

Real bare-remote one-PR simulation checks independent unit then distinct final checker, stale candidate rejection, explicit closing references only for fully covered deliverables, open issues while PR unmerged, and completed state only after simulated user default-branch merge. PR creation response loss finds exactly same PR; evidence comment loss reconciles markers. The helper never merges and live migration PR must remain unmerged/open.

Retain T01..T17/C01..C08/P01..P12 invariant mapping with meaningful migrated equivalents: real CAS/locking/dirty worktree protection, worker liveness and stale envelopes, required assertion-bearing evidence, scoped findings, bounded repairs/replan/deadline, separate final approval, non-force exact artifact publication, descendant/divergent history and terminal/null-active retry. Registry/Markdown tests become explicitly isolated legacy compatibility fixtures, never live fallback. No weakened or skipped checks hidden by renamed methods.

Source policy has short mandatory AGENTS link and detailed issue workflow; all current helper interfaces, live state/reports/instructions/tests distinguish issue/sub-issue/work unit/step. Review every tracked Markdown link and obsolete authority reference. Remove canonical definitions, registry, this proposal, status sections and future FOS allocation instructions; keep research/specifications/evidence without task mirrors. Legacy examples only identified compatibility fixtures/history. Tracked package metadata validates; installed personal skill matches authoritative candidate package with stale files handled.

Independent checker reads original input revision task sections and live issue bodies/relationships, reruns all decisive tests and live audit read-only at exact clean candidate/base/plan, reviews entire diff and actual self-migration artifacts. Production run retains fresh-role evidence, bounds, same one PR and exact remote artifact confirmation. All passing claims state scope; no C++/Vulkan/Steam guarantee inferred.

Implement explicit migrate-state from schema2 (and retained explicit schema1 import path), preserving completed records/history/reports/evidence/legacy allocation facts and the original deadline. Store old active state/provenance, registry union and exact mapping/snapshot. Translate live plans/operations/fields without rewriting historical reports or changing semantic plan version. Acknowledged live implementer migration is permitted only with exact preserved pre-migration dispatch tuple as a one-attempt bridge; no checker approval carries across transition. Staged self-application: implementer commits tested candidate A with new helper and source definitions still present, finishes live issue migration/audit, then pauses and reports candidate A plus mapping and exact migration action/payload to coordinator. Coordinator alone reloads artifact tip, invokes candidate migrate-state on same run, publishes checkpoint, confirms preserved live attempt bridge and sends success. Implementer resumes only after this acknowledgement, removes task definitions/registry and stale guidance, updates retained docs, synchronizes installed personal skill, runs all gates, commits final candidate B and returns the frozen original implementation report envelope. Coordinator records through candidate helper; fresh independent unit and final check follow new issue-evidence closeout. No reset/import into a new run, duplicate worker or fake repair round.

Replace Markdown Done closeout with prepared issue readiness/evidence, no premature closure. Accepted work units and run/PR readiness are separate from issue delivery. Keep current root open; use exact implementation PR closing references so merge into master closes only fully satisfied root/children. Managed evidence comment operations and invalidations have durable markers/recovery; actual PR link is appended after creation and read back without changing source candidate or inventing an early PR. Historical delivered25..27 can be marked completed only on verified existing merge evidence; epics remain open.

Remove canonical task definitions/status/registry and proposal from source only after coordinator self-migration and full live coverage/readback. No generated mirror/archive/task ledger in source. Retain valuable research/specifications/fixtures/sanitized evidence with issue links; historical harness proposal must be rewritten/trimmed so obsolete active allocation/closeout mechanics cannot guide agents. Short AGENTS direction explicitly supersedes forever-registry rule; detailed issue-workflow policy contains no per-task definitions/status. Update index/verification/skill examples and installed package from tracked candidate.

Write actual behavioral regressions with fake gh subprocess + real isolated Git, migrate existing T/C/P fixtures without losing invariants, then independently check final candidate. Every command has real at-most600s deadline; run initial+3repair/1replan/4h budgets unchanged. Final coordinator publishes one source PR and exact orphan artifacts. No source or external mutations by planner/checker; no auto-merge.
